body:
Project-pages milestone (PROJECTS.md, track 9): `twin-ladder` had no figure on its project page.

- `experiments/figure.py` (pure Python, no plotting library) writes `experiments/rho_star.svg`: the pay threshold rho*(r) = 2√r/(1+r) and the seven (r, q) settings of experiment E3, filled when above the threshold. Nothing is simulated; values come from `twin_ladder.rho_star` and the E3 list in `run.py`.
- README reproduce block lists the command; one new test checks the SVG builds and that exactly the q=0.9, r=0.5 setting lies below the threshold, matching `results.txt`.
- `site/build.py` prints `ok` (393 projects) and the project page embeds the figure. Unit tests: 6 pass.
- Run line appended to `prompts/runs.jsonl`.

Merge with a merge commit.
